description: This file defines an interface for representing JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), including methods to access token details such as header, body, issuer, subject, audience, and claims, along with a nested class defining constants for JWT claim fields.

classes.name: JsonWebToken
classes.description: Interface for JWT operations, providing methods to retrieve token components and claims.

classes.name: JsonWebToken.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing static definitions for standard JWT claim fields.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the encoded JWT as a String.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header JSON object of the JWT.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the body JSON object of the JWT.

methods.name: getKeyId
methods.description: Returns the key identifier ('kid') of the JWT.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer ('iss') claim of the JWT.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature part of the JWT.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns a list of subjects ('sub') claims for authorization.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration time ('exp') claim as an Instant.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token is expired based on current time and 'exp' claim.
